Bowel/Colo-rectal Surgery
Bowel preparation should be done for cases in which the colon should be cleansed for surgical reasons.

Systemic antimicrobials should provide coverage for aerobes and anaerobes.

# Outpatient Orders for Bowel Prep Medications

Outpatient orders for Bowel Prep (Golytely+Neomycin PO+Erythromycin PO)

# Inpatient Orders for Bowel Prep Medications

Reglan 10mg PO prior to Golytely

Golytely Bowel Prep

Neomycin 1000 mg PO TID day before surgery

Erythromycin 1000 mg PO TID day before surgery

References:

- Bratzler DW, et al.  Clinical practice guidelines for antimicrobial prophylaxis in surgery, Am J Health-Syst Pharm. 2013, 70: 195-283
- Antimicrobial Prophylaxis for Surgery, Treatment Guidelines from The
- Medical Letter 2012, 10: 73-77
- Sanford keyword: Prophylaxis
Therapy:
## Systemic antimicrobials

## Preferred prophylaxis

Cefazolin 2gm IV over 30 minutes beginning 60 minutes before incision

($) [R] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV over 30 minutes beginning 60 minutes before incision ($) [DI]

## Alternative in patient with beta lactam allergy

Gentamicin 5 MG/KG  IV over 30 minutes ($) R,O beginning 60 minutes
before incision <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV ($) [DI] over 30 minutes beginning 60 minutes before incision
Clindamycin 900mg IV over 30 minutes ($)H,O beginning 60 minutes
before incision <AND> levofloxacin 500mg IV over 60 minutes ($)[R,DI]

beginning 60 minutes before incision.
